body.title: Recovery in Nebraska. All 93 Counties.
paragraphs: Douglas, Lancaster, Sarpy, and Hall counties generate the highest volume of Nebraska foreclosure surplus cases. Nebraska is primarily a judicial foreclosure state, and sheriff sale surplus funds are deposited with the Nebraska district court clerk until claimed by the former owner. Nebraska tax sale certificate foreclosures can also produce excess proceeds that belong to the former property owner.

The Nebraska Unclaimed Property Division, administered by the State Treasurer, holds hundreds of millions in dormant bank accounts, insurance proceeds, uncashed checks, and other assets belonging to Nebraska residents. RCG searches Nebraska district court records, county sheriff sale records, and state unclaimed property databases for every Nebraska client.
body.callout: Claims are filed through our network of licensed attorneys in Nebraska. All recoveries are handled on a pure contingency basis with no upfront cost to the client.
